section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 17, Älvkarleby-Långhäll
section.notes: Final northern Upplandsleden stage, connecting onward to Gästrikeleden at/near Långhäll. Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 7.5 km; downloaded GPX computes to about 7.058 km.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 17 GPX as primary geometry.
The GPX direction matches official prose: Älvkarleby-to-Långhäll.
No internal gap handling is required; one segment with no >500 m steps.
Treat the Gästrikeleden connection as a cross-system connector/context gap of roughly 360 m rather than silently snapping Etapp 17 to Gästrikeleden GPX.
qa: Etapp 16 main endpoint to Etapp 17 start is 0 m.
Etapp 17 endpoint to the official Gästrikeleden Långhäll-Hemlingby/Kågbo-Långhäll geometry is about 364 m depending on which Gästrikeleden endpoint is used.
Långhäll cannot be reached by car according to the official route text; hikers turn back or continue on Gästrikeleden.

importRows.name: Toalett, Laxön / Café Furiren
importRows.notes: Start-area toilet at Laxön/Café Furiren during opening hours. Route prose says Café Kuriren, but the object/source is Café Furiren. Shared with Etapp 16.

importRows.name: Vatten, Laxön / Café Furiren
importRows.notes: Water is available at Café Furiren on Laxön during opening hours. Treat as seasonal/opening-dependent, not a guaranteed 24h tap. Shared with Etapp 16.

importRows.name: Laxön
importRows.notes: Start-area heritage/visitor context on Laxön with restored late-1800s military buildings beside Älvkarlebyfallen. Shared with Etapp 16.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Långhäll
importRows.notes: Stage-end shelter at Långhäll. No car access; hikers must turn back or continue on Gästrikeleden.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Långhäll
importRows.notes: Grill/fireplace at the Långhäll shelter cluster. Check current fire-risk and fire-ban guidance before use.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Långhäll
importRows.notes: Rest area with shelter, grill and benches at Långhäll.

pending.name: Tältmöjlighet, Långhäll
pending.reason: Official shelter page says tenting is possible at Långhäll but grass can be high. No dedicated campsite marker exists, so keep pending unless informal shelter-tenting rows are supported.

pending.name: Djupsjön rastplats/grillplats
pending.reason: Upplandsstiftelsen says there is shelter with fireplace at Djupsjön, while Naturkartan stage prose only supports a small rest spot by a cairn/viewpoint and no official Naturkartan object page was found. Non-official Vindskyddskartan suggests a grill place but no shelter. Keep pending.

pending.name: Höghällsberget fornborg
pending.reason: Official route prose supports a hillfort side trip at Höghällsberget, but the coordinate currently comes from Wikimedia/RAÄ reference metadata rather than a direct Fornsök/Naturkartan point.

pending.name: Gravrösen och stensättning vid Långhäll
pending.reason: Official route prose describes three bronze-age cairns and an oval stone setting, probably a domarring, near Långhäll. Keep as one combined pending heritage feature until a stable Fornsök/official coordinate is chosen.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Älvkarleby
suppressions.notes: Start parking/access metadata only. Shared with Etapp 16.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Älvkarleby Turisten
suppressions.notes: Start transit metadata only. Shared with Etapp 16.

suppressions.name: Tågstation, Älvkarleby
suppressions.notes: Train station access metadata only, about 1.27 km from the Etapp 17 start by straight-line route proximity.

suppressions.name: Laxön commercial visitor services
suppressions.notes: Hotels, cafes, restaurants, hostel and shops on Laxön are context only unless the app maintains current commercial-service rows. Water/toilet at Café Furiren is represented separately.

suppressions.name: Djupsjön fishing membership context
suppressions.notes: Official route text says fishing in Djupsjön requires membership in Älvkarleby sportfiskeklubb. Do not import fishing as an activity/facility.

suppressions.name: Small water source before Långhäll
suppressions.notes: Långhäll shelter page says hikers pass a small water source shortly before Långhäll, but no coordinate or potable status was verified. Do not import as water.

suppressions.name: Gästrikeleden connection at Långhäll
suppressions.notes: Onward route connection only. Official prose says Gästrikeleden connects here, but official Gästrikeleden GPX endpoints are about 360 m away; do not silently snap without an explicit connector.

suppressions.name: Långhällskogen nature reserve context
suppressions.notes: Reserve context beyond the Upplandsleden endpoint and more relevant when continuing on Gästrikeleden. Rules include no fires and dogs leashed; suppress as normal Etapp 17 POI.

suppressions.name: Gävleborg reserve storm-damage context
suppressions.notes: If continuing into Gävleborg reserves, check current reserve notices. Länsstyrelsen Gävleborg warned of storm-felled trees after storm Johannes on 2025-12-27 in some reserves.

suppressions.name: Fire-risk and fire-ban context
suppressions.notes: Check Uppsala/Gävleborg fire-risk and fire-ban guidance before using fireplaces; Långhällskogen reserve beyond the endpoint forbids fires.

suppressions.name: Etapp 16 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 16-specific rows except shared Älvkarleby/Laxön endpoint context. Do not import Marma, Storfjärden, Ambricka, Gropholmarna or Etapp 16-only Laxön rows into Etapp 17.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe Älvkarleby/Laxön start services and access with Etapp 16. Keep transport rows metadata-only. Treat Gästrikeleden as route connection metadata, not a normal POI.

iterationLog.focus: First batch pass for Etapp 17 using official route pages, clean GPX QA, Långhäll/Laxön object pages, Gästrikeleden connection context, reserve/fire/access metadata and POI uncertainty review.
iterationLog.result: Created standalone Etapp 17 research file. Normal imports cover Laxön toilet/water/heritage and Långhäll shelter/fire/rest. Långhäll tenting, Djupsjön rest/fireplace, Höghällsberget and Långhäll cairns/domarring remain pending. Start access, Laxön commercial context, Djupsjön fishing, Långhäll water, Gästrikeleden/Långhällskogen/fire/storm context and Etapp 16 leakage are metadata-only or suppressed.

iterationLog.summary: Quality pass for Etapp 17: rechecked JSON structure, source references, GPX/mapdata drawability, declared counts and unsupported type risk against the full numbered Upplandsleden set.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary evidence remains the official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen route material already cited in this file; no new row was promoted solely from unsourced inference.
nextIterationNeeds: Replace any GPX-snapped coordinates named in validation limitations with exact Naturkartan/object or municipal coordinates.
Re-check seasonal/commercial/pending services before final import.

iterationLog.summary: Integration/dedupe pass for Etapp 17: compared rows against adjacent and same-coordinate etapper to flag shared endpoints, repeated access metadata and route/loop leakage for later import consolidation.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Rows remain section-scoped for traceability; actual app import should use the separate dedupe registry generated in this pass to collapse canonical shared facilities.
nextIterationNeeds: Apply canonical dedupe groups during import rather than importing each section-scoped duplicate as a separate public facility.
Keep access-only parking/transit suppressions out of normal facility imports unless the app gains an access layer.

iterationLog.summary: Reviewed existing deep-source coverage for Etapp 17; retained object-confirmed high-confidence rows and kept 4 pending/context rows out of normal import.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Object-level Naturkartan/official sources were preferred; rows without strong current import evidence remain pending or medium-confidence where appropriate.
nextIterationNeeds: Use dedupe registry during app integration to collapse shared endpoint facilities.

iterationLog.summary: Final quality pass for Etapp 17: checked source keys, import/pending/suppression counts, decision coverage, adjacent-section duplicates and mapdata drawability.
iterationLog.sourceReview: The section is now at the same integration-readiness standard as the strengthened Etapp 1-9 set, with remaining caveats carried explicitly in validation limitations.
nextIterationNeeds: No further section-level enrichment needed before integration beyond global dedupe/import policy.

validation.transportMetadataPolicy: Rows in decisions.transportMetadataOnly are retained in suppressions with metadataRole access_transport_metadata; they are planning/deduplication records and should not become normal facility imports unless the integration policy changes.
validation.mapCanDrawCondition: Draw/use the official Naturkartan Etapp 17 GPX as a clean one-segment route. Keep Gästrikeleden continuation as route-connection metadata rather than snapping geometries together.
validation.previewNotGenerated: Standalone research file only; import preview will be generated during later integration.
checks: Iteration 2 quality pass: source keys, declared counts, supported import types, decision coverage and mapdata drawability revalidated across all numbered Upplandsleden etapper.
Iteration 3 integration pass: cross-etapp coordinate/name clusters audited and duplicate-prone shared endpoint rows classified for later import dedupe.
Iteration 4 deepening pass: object-level sources, coordinates and section relevance rechecked against official/Naturkartan material.
Iteration 5 final pass: dedupe-aware integration readiness, source coverage, counts and decision buckets revalidated.
limitations: 2 import row(s) intentionally remain medium-confidence because exact/current object evidence is weaker or the item is contextual rather than an ordinary facility.
